messages.subject: Units of measurement for AD_MVPA_E5S_B10M80%_T93.2_ENMO
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

Just requesting a bit of help in determining the units for the data from the variable labelled AD_MVPA_E5S_B10M80%_T93.2_ENMO

So, my understanding is that this is measuring the average MVPA in 5 second epochs, bouts of 10 mins, where ENMO is above the threshold of 93.2mg for 80% of the time. But that is where i come unstuck as I would be expecting a whole number (and not very large) from this variable e.g. value of 3 = 3x10 mins bouts above the threshold (therefore 30 minutes MVPA in total). However, my data is showing fractions of large numbers (up to 80.69) so this interpretation has to be incorrect.

Could anyone interpret for me what a value of 80.69 means?

Kind regards,

Kiya

messages.subject: Units of measurement for AD_MVPA_E5S_B10M80%_T93.2_ENMO
messages.body_plain:
Hi Kiya,
Actually, this variable does not have to be multiple of 10 in case this is what you refer to. Bouts of 10 min include activity maintained for at least 10 min, as minimum. If the activity is maintained for more time, it is also part of this variable. So, this is also the explanation for why this variable is not an integer number.

Consider also that the variable is a mean of the valid days, so if you have 4 valid days and 3 bouts of exactly 10 min, this mean will not be an integer.

Best,
Jairo

messages.subject: bout.metric question
messages.body_plain:
Hi Vincent,

We analyzed a small set of data using GGIR v. 1.2-8 and GGIR v. 1.5-12 to estimate MVPA.

One run used v. 1.2-8 with mvpa.2014=FALSE and closedbout=FALSE.
A second run used v. 1.5-12 with bout.metric=1 and closedbout=FALSE, and produced the same MVPA estimates as the first run.
A third run used v. 1.5-12 with bout.metric=2 and closedbout=FALSE, and produced higher MVPA estimates than the other two runs.

All runs used do.imp = FALSE.

Based on the documentation of bout.metric in the manual, we expected bout.metric=2 and closedbout=FALSE to match mvpa.2014=FALSE and closedbout=FALSE.

We want to be sure our understanding of the bout processing is correct. The manual version 1.5-12 states on page 24, on bout.metric = 1: "Here, the algorithm looks for 10 minute windows in which more than XX percent of the epochs are above mvpathreshold, and then counts the entire window as mvpa."

We're assuming that bout.metric = 1 with closedbout = FALSE does not count periods of inactivity within a 10-minute bout toward the total MVPA, even though this contradicts the manual. Is our interpretation correct?

Thanks.
